# JSTOR Daily

> JSTOR Daily delivers scholarship-backed news, analysis, and curated educational resources connecting academic research to contemporary culture and history.

JSTOR Daily is the public-facing platform of JSTOR, offering accessible articles, reading lists, primary source collections, and multimedia content for students, educators, and lifelong learners. The site emphasizes cultural history, social history, and archival discovery across topics ranging from architecture and entertainment to South Asian trade and the Space Race.

## Key Topics

## Core Navigation & Features

- [JSTOR Daily Homepage](https://daily.jstor.org): Homepage featuring scholarship-backed news and analysis across all topics
- [Sign Up for JSTOR Daily Newsletters](https://daily.jstor.org/newsletter): Subscribe to the Weekly Digest and curated content recommendations
- [The JSTOR Daily Sleuth](https://daily.jstor.org/jstor-daily-sleuth): Interactive game testing detection of authentic vs. AI-generated academic paper titles

## Teaching & Learning Resources

- [Teaching and Learning Resources from JSTOR Daily](https://daily.jstor.org/teaching-and-learning-resources-from-jstor-daily): Reading lists, syllabi, classroom activities, and pedagogical resources for educators
- [Reading Lists Archives](https://daily.jstor.org/series/reading-lists): Expert-curated reading lists archive for teaching and learning across disciplines
- [Rights of Nature: A Reading List](https://daily.jstor.org/rights-of-nature-a-reading-list): Curated reading list on environmental law and rights of nature
- [Collections on JSTOR Archives](https://daily.jstor.org/type/shared-collections-jstor): Shared Collections featuring primary sources, images, and historical archives

## Featured Columns & Series

- [In the Limelight Archives](https://daily.jstor.org/column/in-the-limelight): Archive column covering entertainment, cultural, and media history
- [Archive Adventures Archives](https://daily.jstor.org/column/archive-adventures): Column featuring historical figures and forgotten cultural stories from the archives
- [The Where We Were Archives](https://daily.jstor.org/column/the-where-we-were): Architecture and design history column covering historic buildings and architectural styles
- [Roundup Archives](https://daily.jstor.org/series/roundup): Curated seasonal and thematic roundup collections and editors' picks

## Cultural History & Society

- [Gender Play in Nineteenth-Century Theater](https://daily.jstor.org/gender-play-in-nineteenth-century-theater): Article on women performers and gender norms in 19th-century theater
- [How America's Industrial Elite Built Their Own Palaces](https://daily.jstor.org/how-americas-industrial-elite-built-their-own-palaces): Article on Gilded Age architecture in Cleveland's Millionaires' Row and Richardsonian Romanesque design
- [Celebrating Women's History Month](https://daily.jstor.org/womens-history-month-editors-picks): Women's History Month curated articles and scholarly resources

## Global History & Cultures

- [How Horses Shaped the Mughal Empire](https://daily.jstor.org/how-horses-shaped-the-mughal-empire): Article on horse trade and diplomacy in the Mughal Empire
- [Caste and Culture in Kolkata's Chinese Leather Trade](https://daily.jstor.org/caste-and-culture-in-kolkatas-chinese-leather-trade): Article on Hakka Chinese leather trade and caste dynamics in Kolkata
- [The Space Race's Forgotten Theme Park](https://daily.jstor.org/the-space-races-forgotten-theme-park): Article on Space Race-era theme park with archival photographs and historical documents

## Multimedia & Podcasts

- [Perspectives on Public Space: A JSTOR Daily Podcast](https://daily.jstor.org/perspectives-on-public-space-a-jstor-daily-podcast): Podcast series exploring public space, urban design, and community
